biography.heading: About the
biography.intro: Adorned with infinite divine glory, the most revered Shrimat Jagadguru Avadhutacharya Swami Dr. Sundar Giri Maharaj shines as a brilliant star of the Sanatana spiritual world. Being a wandering sannyasi (Paribrajaak) of the Shri Panchadashanami sect, his pre-monastic name and identity are withheld in accordance with tradition.

lineage.title: Origin & Lineage
lineage.text: Born in the Jadavpur area of South Kolkata, he is the last heir of the Chandranath Dham's serving family from the Chittagong region of undivided Bengal — a Nath Yogi Rudraj Brahmin by lineage.

academia.title: Academic Excellence
academia.text: He holds doctorates in two disciplines: Biological Chemistry Applied in Medical Science, and Dermatoglyphics as used in Forensic Science.

media.title: Before Sannyasa
media.text: In his pre-monastic life, he served as Chief News Editor for ETV and Zee News (Eastern Region), managing one of India's largest news networks.

initiation.title: Sannyasa Initiation — 2004
initiation.text: At the Prayagraj Maha Kumbh Mela in 2004, he received sannyasa diksha from Brahmalin Shri Mahant Kishor Giri Maharaj at Shri Panchadashanami Juna Akhara, and was elected Mahant the following year.

titles.title: Sacred Titles
titles.text: He long held the revered title of 'Shri Shri 1008 Mahamandaleshwar', and currently occupies the highest seat in the Shakta tradition — 'Shrimat Jagadguru Avadhutacharya'.

global.title: Global Leadership
global.text: He serves as Global Chairperson of 'The Hindu Mission' — the world's oldest Sanatani Hindu organisation, established in 1752, now active across nine countries worldwide.

service.title: Service & Trusteeship
service.text: He serves as Pithadhishwara of Shri Shri Kalika Mahashaktipeetham Kalighat and Shri Shri Baba Tarakeshwar Development Trust, among many other spiritual and social organisations.
